note: A reference declared `exactly one` denotes nothing here. A direct obligation on it is violated with the count, not vacuously satisfied: the reference's own cardinality is part of what the sentence asserts. (A term denoting nothing is different: `Every` over an empty set is satisfied, see universal-empty-subject-set-is-satisfied.)
sentences: $Vault$ refers to exactly one $gallery$ where name is "Vault".
$Vault$ must @be inspected@ within the last #6 months#.
